name: Prowler
amenities: Full galley with refrigeration and prep space
Front lounge and private rear lounge
description: Prowler is a Prevost entertainer coach converted with twelve bunks and a single slide-out that widens the main lounge once the coach is parked. It carries a full galley, a front lounge and a private rear lounge, and a stand-up bathroom with an onboard shower, so the crew sleeps and eats on board while the coach moves between cities. Every booking includes a CDL-certified driver and 24/7 dispatch. Rates are quoted per tour against your routing and dates.
